## 016795030ca2

**Reproduced defect — undeclared joint-axis domain restrictions.** I loaded the assigned generator bytes (`c43d7a3e7190be7ad3f137d8996eed8daa00614127cf6b006cf7788042a65190`) and exhaustively tried the full declared Cartesian product at `seed=0`, `sample_index=0`: `grid_h 9..16 × grid_w 9..16 × block_size 1..3 × n_motifs 1..2 × texture {plain,clip_edge}` = `768` combinations. Only `467` were accepted; `301` raised `ValueError`, while every accepted case had zero observable-axis mismatch. The module has no `INCOMPATIBLE_OVERRIDE_COMBINATIONS` declaration.

A minimized counterexample is `grid_h=9, grid_w=9, block_size=1, n_motifs=1, texture='clip_edge'`, which is individually inside every advertised domain but raises: `incompatible exact axes: cannot place ... on 9x9 without merging motifs or overlapping projections`.

This is a public-domain/override-contract defect, not evidence that the labels or Racket semantics are wrong. No target files were changed. Full matrix, first rejected cases, and hashes: `checks/audit/016795030ca2/joint-axis-probe.json`.
